First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Expect 13 mph: you can talk the whole way.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the NMTS Start the Week Rite Ride (4th Monday) group ride

NMTS Start the Week Rite Ride (4th Monday) is a road and social group ride in Albuquerque, NM. It rolls fourth Monday of the month at 10:00 am from O’Bean’s.

A monthly easy-pace ride of about 20 miles on bike trails and bike lanes, led by Tom Sullivan. It began as a birthday ride for the club treasurer in 2013. The club calls it a good beginner ride.
